state.objective: Identify the root cause of connection pool timeout errors in payment-gateway.

context.content: Architecture: payment-gateway connects to Postgres via PgBouncer with pool_size=20.
2026-10-03T10:01:23Z [ERROR] connection pool exhausted: active=20 idle=0 waiting=42; leaked_conn_holding_stack at billing.py:144 acquire_conn() without release in stripe_webhook_handler

submitted_answer.answer: The Stripe webhook handler acquires database connections at billing.py:144 without releasing them, exhausting the 20-connection pool and causing 5-second acquisition timeouts.
